summary.en: Pakistan is responding to a series of Afghan Taliban attacks along the border, including mortar fire that killed one civilian and wounded five, and a cross-border strike that injured a family, by pounding Taliban positions and destroying border check posts. The Pakistani army also struck Taliban posts after a deadly attack that killed one and injured five people. These retaliatory operations follow the Taliban’s mortar fire and cross-border attacks, escalating the frontier clash. The conflict recorded 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Pakistan svarer på en rekke afghanske Taliban-angrep langs grensen, inkludert morterild som drepte en sivil og såret fem, og et grensekryssende angrep som skadet en familie, ved å slå mot Taliban-posisjoner og ødelegge grensekontrollposter. Den pakistanske hæren slo også Taliban-poster etter et dødelig angrep som drepte en og såret fem personer. Disse gjengjeldelsesoperasjonene følger Taliban-s morterild og grensekryssende angrep, og eskalerer grensekonflikten. Konflikten registrerte 1 794 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
